story.title: Fix GPU memory leak when switching models

events.body: After loading and unloading several models, GPU memory is not freed until the server restarts. Eventually new models fail to load.
events.title: GPU memory keeps growing after switching between models

events.body: Releases the KV cache buffers when a model is unloaded. Fixes #12001.

cannedOutput.headline: ollama v0.12.4 fixes a GPU memory leak when switching models
cannedOutput.whatHappened: The ollama project published version 0.12.4. It fixes a bug where graphics card memory was not freed after switching between AI models.
cannedOutput.previously: Users reported that memory kept growing each time a model was unloaded. After a while, new models could fail to load until the server restarted.
cannedOutput.whatChanged: When a model is unloaded, ollama now frees the memory buffers it was holding. The release also improves the error message when a model file is missing.
cannedOutput.whyItMatters: People who run several local AI models on one machine can switch between them without restarting the server or running out of graphics memory.
cannedOutput.nextConfirmed: No next step has been announced.

glossary.definition: A graphics card, a chip that is very good at the math AI models need.
A bug where a program keeps memory it no longer needs, so free memory slowly runs out.
Short-term memory a language model keeps while it works, so it does not redo earlier steps.

cannedOutput.analogy: It is like a library that never put returned books back on the shelf, until the shelves were full. Now returned books go back right away.
cannedOutput.intermediate: Pull request #12345 frees the KV cache buffers on model unload, closing issue #12001. It is included in v0.12.4.
cannedOutput.technical: Model unload now releases KV cache buffers that previously stayed allocated on the GPU (#12345, fixes #12001). The v0.12.4 notes also list an improved missing-model-file error.
